title: Note on KSW-allowability of Wine-Glass Geometry
summary: In this note we consider no-boundary instantons and wine-glass geometries which are of interest in the context of quantum cosmology. While the former usually appears as a dominant saddle in the path-integral, the wineglass geometry can become dominant saddle in some situations. The later has been argued to have a longer inflationary phase of the Universe. Kontsevich-Segal-Witten (KSW)-allowability criterion which classifies geometries on the basis of the requirement of having a meaningful QFT on it, pushes one to analyse the allowability of the various geometries.
